senses.gloss:
Nihākā in the Rigveda^1 and the Taittirīya Saṃhitā^2 appears
to denote some phenomenon of a storm, perhaps the ‘whirl-
wind.’
1) x. 97, 13.
2) vii. 5, 11, 1 (following nīhāra).

Nīhāra, ‘mist,’ occurs in the Rigveda^1 and later.^2
1) x. 82, 7.
2) Taittirīya Saṃhitā, vii. 5, 11, 1;
Kāṭhaka Saṃhitā, xxviii. 4; Vājasaneyi
Saṃhitā, xxii. 26; xxv. 9; Av. vi. 113,
2; xviii. 3, 60; Taittirīya Āraṇyaka,
i. 10, 7; vi. 4, 1; Chāndogya Upaniṣad,
iii. 19, 2, etc.
